attchmntText: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet.
voiceSummary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited, trading as UTL Solar, has intimated the schedule for an investor and analyst meeting. The event is scheduled for Monday, November 23, 2026. It will include a plant visit at the Greater Noida and Dadri facilities. This will be followed by a management meet with analysts and investors. The meeting format is physical. The company states that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. Discussions will be limited to general information already in the public domain. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. Details are available on the company website. The intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued on November 18, 2026. attchmntText: National Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Transfer of Shares to Investor Education and Protection Fund pursuant toSection 124(6) of the Companies Act, 2013.'.
voiceSummary: National Fertilizers Limited transferred 1207 equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority pursuant to Section 124 of the Companies Act, 2013. The transfer was executed through the National Securities Depository Limited. This action was taken in accordance with the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority Accounting, Audit, Transfer and Refund Rules, 2016. The company has informed the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding this transfer. The announcement was issued on 18th November 2026. Ashok Jha, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication. The NSE symbol for the company is NFL. The BSE scrip code is 523630.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited filed an investors presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 86.02 Cr for Q2 FY27, up 10.75% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 11.34 Cr with a margin of 13.18%. Profit after tax was Rs. 4.95 Cr, reflecting a 21.21% year-on-year increase. Earnings per share were Rs. 2.23. For the half year, revenue reached Rs. 161.88 Cr and PAT was Rs. 9.31 Cr. The unexecuted order book stood at Rs. 624.22 Cr as of September 30, 2026. The board approved the amalgamation of Markolines Infra Limited into the company on March 6, 2026, with SEBI clearance obtained. The presentation was uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: Press Release on Rs. 161 Crore Equity Issuance pursuant to Warrant Conversion
voiceSummary: Parag Milk Foods Limited announced the allotment of 90 lakh equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each following the conversion of share warrants. The company received a total issue consideration of Rs. 161 crore, including Rs. 121 crore received upon conversion. The balance exercise price was Rs. 134.32 per warrant, representing 75% of the warrant price of Rs. 179.10. Of the allotted shares, 60 lakh were allotted to promoters and 30 lakh to non-promoter investors, including an employee. The preferential issue was approved by shareholders on May 3, 2025. Proceeds will be used for debt reduction, working capital, capital expenditure, and general corporate purposes.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange about Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call Transcript
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited submitted the Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call Transcript to the BSE and NSE on 18th November 2026. The transcript covers the call held on 12th November 2026. For Q2 FY27, total revenue was INR267 crores, up 23% year-on-year. EBITDA was INR47 crores, up 32.8%, with a margin of 17.6%. Profit after tax was INR33 crores, up 43%. For H1 FY27, total revenue was INR510 crores, up 19%. EBITDA was INR90 crores, up 28%. Profit after tax was INR63 crores, up 39%. The Gasket and Heat Shield division contributed 51% of revenues. The Forging division secured INR500 crores in new orders. The company plans INR103 crores in capex for FY27. Management guided for 18% to 20% organic growth for FY27.

attchmntText: The Karnataka Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Udaya Kumar Hebbar as Additional Director in the capacity of Whole Time Director (Managing Director & CEO) of the company w.e.f. November 18, 2026.
voiceSummary: Karnataka Bank appointed Mr. Udaya Kumar Hebbar, DIN 07235226, as Additional Director and Whole Time Director in the category of Managing Director and CEO on November 18, 2026. The appointment is for a period of three years from the date of assuming charge. The Reserve Bank of India conveyed its approval on November 16, 2026. Mr. Hebbar has over 40 years of experience in banking. He is not related to any existing directors of the Bank. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The date of assuming charge will be intimated separately.

attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "HIRECT receives a letter of acceptance for Appx. ₹ 136.26 Crore Order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for 900 Traction Motors for WAG-9 Electric Locomotives".
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited received a letter of acceptance for an order valued at approximately Rs. 136.26 crore from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works. The order is for the supply of 900 three-phase asynchronous traction motors for WAG-9 electric locomotives. Supplies are scheduled to be executed in a phased manner between January 2027 and December 2027. The order includes a warranty period of 78 months from the date of delivery. This announcement was made via a press release dated November 18, 2026. The company is formerly known as Hind Rectifiers Limited.

attchmntText: Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "Adani Cement Flags Off Heavy-Duty Electric Trucks for Clinker & Cement Transport".
voiceSummary: Ambuja Cements Limited filed a media release on November 18, 2026, regarding the flagging off of heavy-duty electric trucks for clinker and cement transport. The deployment commenced at the Sanghi Plant in Gujarat. Adani Cement plans to deploy 410 electric trucks by March 2027 as part of its first phase plan. This fleet is projected to reduce over 25,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide annually. The company targets 10 percent logistics road volume through electric trucks by 2030, with a deployment of over 2000 electric vehicles. The initiative aims to eliminate freight emissions and reduce diesel consumption.

attchmntText: Gateway Distriparks Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "Gateway Distriparks Wins Contract to Operate Common Rail Yard at JNPA".
voiceSummary: Gateway Distriparks Limited has been awarded an eight-year contract for the operations and management of the Dedicated Freight Corridor compliant common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority in Nhava Sheva. The award was announced on November 18, 2026. Under the agreement, the company will handle train placement, segregation of mixed container trains, container handling, stacking, and inter-terminal transfers. This facility is one of only two within the port equipped with 1,500-metre-long railway lines compatible with long-haul container trains. The contract expands Gateway Distriparks Limited's service portfolio beyond its existing container rail transportation, inland container depot, and container freight station operations. The company already operates a container freight station at this location. This development aims to improve coordination and optimize the utilization of the port's rail infrastructure.

attchmntText: Puravankara Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release dated November 18, 2026, titled  Puravankara launches Purva Cityspire in Kochi with ₹2,000 crore GDV .
voiceSummary: Puravankara Limited has launched Purva Cityspire in Kochi with a gross development value of 2,000 crore rupees. The project is part of an 18-acre integrated township in Edappally. It comprises 1,056 premium two and three-bedroom residences across six towers. Prices start at 1.44 crore rupees. The development features over 50% open spaces and more than 40 lifestyle amenities. The project is registered with the Kerala Real Estate Regulatory Authority in three phases. Phase one has a proposed completion date of 31 July 2031. Phase two is scheduled for 31 July 2032. Phase three is scheduled for 30 June 2033. The company states that residential property values in the area have appreciated by approximately 11% year-on-year. Non-resident Indians account for an estimated 20 to 30 percent of demand in Kochi.

attchmntText: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Scrutinizers report of Annual General Meeting held on 24th September 2025.
voiceSummary: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited reports the voting results of its 60th Annual General Meeting held on September 24, 2025. Mr. Mohan Ram Goenka of MR & Associates served as the scrutinizer. All resolutions placed before members were passed with the requisite majority. The resolutions included the adoption of audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2025. Mr. Tarun Chaturvedi, DIN 02309045, was re-appointed as a director. The company approved statutory auditor remuneration for the financial year 2025-26. Ratification of cost auditor remuneration was approved. The appointment of the secretarial auditor for a period of 5 years was approved. A special resolution to alter the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association was passed. Voting was conducted via remote e-voting and e-voting during the meeting through Central Depository Services India Limited.

attchmntText: Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: Hindcon Chemicals Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 5 November 2026. The Board reviewed and approved the Un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. This includes Statements of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flows for the half year. The Board also noted the Limited Review Report issued by Statutory Auditors. The meeting commenced at 12:30 P.M. and concluded at 3:45 P.M. The results are placed before the National Stock Exchange for information. Copies of the financial statements are enclosed with the announcement. The Company operates in a single business segment comprising sodium silicate and construction chemicals. No exceptional items were recorded during the period.

attchmntText: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of 21,253 equity shares pursuant to the OFSS Stock Plan, 2014.'.
voiceSummary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited has announced the allotment of 21,253 equity shares to eligible employees who exercised stock options under the OFSS Stock Plan 2014. The ESOP Allotment Committee approved this allotment on November 18, 2026. Each share has a face value of Rs. 5. The company did not allot any shares to directors in this transaction. The newly allotted shares rank pari passu with existing equity shares. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up capital has increased to Rs. 435,789,375. This capital is divided into 87,157,875 equity shares of face value Rs. 5 each. The intimation will be published on the company website. Onkarnath Banerjee, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, issued this notice.

attchmntText: Ginni Filaments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Resubmission'.
voiceSummary: Ginni Filaments Limited submitted unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in machine-readable format following an observation by the National Stock Exchange. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 2, 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 933.35 lakhs, compared to 1,025.59 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, net profit was 1,838.65 lakhs, versus 2,086.61 lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 10,121.25 lakhs for the quarter and 20,410.10 lakhs for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 34,340.97 lakhs. The statutory auditors, Doogar & Associates, issued a clean review report.

attchmntText: NCL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: NCL Industries Limited filed the transcript of its earnings call held on November 13, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved Phase 2 and 3 of a solar and wind power project in Tuticorin, adding 80 megawatts at an estimated cost of INR 595 crores. The total 130 megawatts project requires an aggregate investment of approximately INR 987 crores. The company is also exploring setting up a cement plant in Orissa. For the second quarter, revenue from operations stood at INR 386 crores, with EBITDA at INR 37 crores. Cement sales volumes grew by 16 percent. The Bison Panel division reduced selling prices by approximately 17 to 20 percent.
